About Us

Built by practitioners, for practitioners

We don't sell AI dreams. We deliver working systems.

Our Story

The One Group started with a simple observation: most AI "solutions" are just demos. They look impressive in a sales pitch, but fall apart in the real world.

We saw SMB owners getting burned by over-promised AI tools that required teams of engineers to maintain. The barrier to entry was too high. The complexity was too much.

So we built something different.

We focus on practical AI — systems that work on day one, improve over time, and don't require a PhD to manage. Our agents learn your business, adapt to your workflow, and actually deliver ROI.

Multi-Model Intelligence

We don't just use one AI. We route tasks to the best model for the job. Cost-optimized, capability-matched.

GPT-4 Fast, cheap — Simple tasks, quick responses, routine automation
Claude Nuanced reasoning — Complex analysis, creative writing, careful review
Gemini Massive context — Document analysis, code reviews, multi-turn conversations
GPT-5.4 Codex Code expertise — Development tasks, debugging, technical implementation
